name: Goblet squat
summary: Holding a weight at the chest, squat deep with the elbows inside the knees and the chest up.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone, a dumbbell held vertically at the chest. Sit down between the heels until the thighs are at or below parallel, keeping the chest up, then stand.
brief: Stand with a dumbbell held vertically at the chest. Sit down between the heels until the thighs are at or below parallel, chest up, then stand.
why: From the side the knee angle gives depth and the shoulder–hip line shows the trunk folding forward, which the weight at the chest tends to prevent.
contraindications: Knee pain at depth; lower back pain with the weight.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Heels lifting
faults.tip: Spread the floor with the feet; heels stay planted.

faults.label: Lower back rounding at the bottom
faults.tip: Squat only as deep as the lower back stays neutral.

faults.label: Weight drifting away from the chest
faults.tip: The weight rests against the chest. Letting it drift out pulls you forward.

guide.cannotSee: The knees caving — a front-view detail.

points.t: Chest up; weight tight to the body.
